subject: Portal continuity, SIG stitching, and owner map for Greenline Health onboarding
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: portal-support@vendr.com, alice.wu@greenlinehealth.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Portal continuity, SIG stitching, and owner map for Greenline Health onboarding

Hi team,

We're kicking off Greenline Health's vendor portal onboarding and want to avoid duplicative evidence uploads across SIG/CAIQ/Whistic imports. The ask: consolidate their existing profile, stitch SIG answers to our canonical SIG matrix, and produce an owner map so we know who owns each evidence item after handoff.

Specifics:
- Source portal: Vendr (portal link below). Greenline already started answers and uploaded S3 artifacts.
- Required outputs from your side: CAIQ export (JSON), a diff report vs. our canonical SIG template, and a suggested owner mapping CSV.
- Constraints: Greenline needs evidence TTL/rotation guidance (90/180-day refresh) surfaced in the portal and the ability to assign multiple internal owners (Security, Infra, Product).

I've attached a draft sig_mapping_v1.xlsx that shows our canonical fields and where we expect vendor-provided answers to land. Can you confirm Vendr can produce a CAIQ/CSV export and a staged export of S3 object keys so we can bulk-import without re-uploading duplicates?

Next steps: portal-support, can you confirm the export options and estimated timeline? Marissa / Mina / Soojin — once Vendr confirms, let's schedule a 45-minute handoff to align owners and the rotation cadence.

Thanks,

Jonas Weber
Senior Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sig_mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: portal_access_instructions.txt (text)
From: portal-support@vendr.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com
Cc: alice.wu@greenlinehealth.com
Date: 2027-01-18T14:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal continuity, SIG stitching, and owner map for Greenline Health onboarding

Hi Jonas / Marissa / team,

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. We can definitely provide the artifacts you requested. Quick answers up-front:
- CAIQ export: yes — we can generate a CAIQ-formatted JSON export for the profile.
- Answer diff: we produce a field-level diff CSV that highlights mismatches from a supplied canonical template.
- Evidence export: we can generate a manifest of S3 keys (or provide a signed S3 list) — full object transfer is possible via SFTP or a short-lived signed URL list if you prefer not to re-upload.

Proposed timeline:
1) Verify API/SFTP access to Greenline's evidence bucket — 1 business day after access confirmed.
2) Generate CAIQ export + diff report — 2 business days.
3) Produce owner-map CSV template (we'll pre-fill from their current labels) — 1 business day.

Questions:
1) For the canonical SIG template, do you want us to map to the Redwood master column headers exactly (yes/no)?
2) For rotation TTLs, do you require automated reminders in Vendr or just the owner map + suggested cadence?

If you confirm the above two points, we'll queue this under our "profile-migration" sprint and aim to deliver the exports by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Sara Patel
Customer Success / Vendr Portal Operations
portal-support@vendr.com

--
Vendr Portal: https://vendr.com/portal/organizations/greenline-health/profile
From: jonas.weber@redwood.com
To: portal-support@vendr.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, mina.haddad@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com, alice.wu@greenlinehealth.com
Date: 2027-01-19T08:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal continuity, SIG stitching, and owner map for Greenline Health onboarding

Sara — thanks. Answers inline below: 

1) Map to Redwood master headers exactly — yes. Please use the column names in the attached sig_mapping_v1.xlsx as the canonical target. If a field doesn't have a direct mapping, flag it in the diff CSV and add a short rationale column.

2) Automated reminders in Vendr would be ideal — set reminders for primary owner and a CC to the secondary owner 30 days before TTL expiration. Suggested TTLs: 90 days for infra/config proofs (keys, cert screenshots), 180 days for process docs (policies, org charts). If the portal can't do multi-owner reminders, the owner-map + manual reminders is acceptable.

Access details: we've provisioned a temporary read-only IAM role for the Greenline S3 bucket. Credentials were shared with portal-support via a secure transfer — please confirm receipt and whether you prefer SFTP ingestion instead (we can provision an endpoint).

Marissa / Mina / Soojin — once Vendr confirms receipt of credentials, let's book 45 minutes on Friday to walk through the diff report and finalize owners. I'm attaching the same sig_mapping_v1.xlsx for reference.

Thanks,
Jonas

Attachment: sig_mapping_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: marissa.cole@redwood.com
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com, portal-support@vendr.com
Cc: mina.haddad@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com, alice.wu@greenlinehealth.com
Date: 2027-01-20T15:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Portal continuity, SIG stitching, and owner map for Greenline Health onboarding

All — quick confirmation from our side: Vendr confirmed they received the temporary IAM credentials via the secure transfer and have kicked off the CAIQ export. They asked us to confirm the final meeting time. I proposed the following slots in Calendly and included the Greenline security contact (Alice) so she can finalize attendance.

Proposed 45-minute windows (PT):
- Friday 2027-01-22 09:00–09:45
- Friday 2027-01-22 13:00–13:45

Agenda:
- Quick recap (5m)
- Walk through CAIQ export and diff report (20m)
- Agree owner map and TTLs (15m)
- Next actions and evidence handoff plan (5m)

Action items:
- Vendr: deliver CAIQ + diff CSV before the meeting and pre-populate owner map template.
- Greenline (Alice): confirm which internal owners should be primary for infra vs policy artifacts.
- Redwood (Marissa/Mina/Soojin): validate mappings and confirm TTL policy.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite once Alice confirms the slot.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Vendor Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
